items: Please ____ that all expense reports are signed before submitting them to accounting.
'Ensure' means make certain that something happens or is true.
The account manager ____ the client that the replacement parts would arrive by Friday.
'Assured' means told someone confidently in order to remove doubt.
The company ____ the warehouse against fire damage before storing valuable equipment there.
'Insured' means provided insurance coverage against a specified risk.
After a six-month trial, the board voted to formally ____ the new code of conduct.
'Adopt' means formally accept and begin using a policy, plan, or practice.
The scheduling software can ____ to sudden changes in staffing levels.
'Adapt to' means adjust to changed conditions.
The customer service desk is open every weekday ____ national holidays.
'Except' introduces something excluded from a general statement.
The supplier agreed to ____ the revised payment terms without further negotiation.
'Accept' means agree to receive or approve something offered.
Unexpected shipping delays may ____ the delivery dates shown in the current schedule.
'Affect' is the verb meaning influence or cause a change in something.
The revised advertising campaign had an immediate ____ on online sales.
'Effect' is a noun meaning a result or consequence.
The ____ reason for postponing the launch was a delay in safety certification.
'Principal' as an adjective means main or most important.
Customer privacy is a guiding ____ of the company's data-handling policy.
'Principle' is a noun meaning a fundamental rule or belief.
The human resources department is hiring additional ____ for the new distribution center.
'Personnel' means the employees or staff of an organization.
Employees should not leave ____ belongings in the conference room overnight.
'Personal' describes something belonging to or concerning an individual person.
The warm wood panels ____ the neutral colors used throughout the renovated lobby.
'Complement' as a verb means combine well with something and enhance it.
A customer wrote to ____ the staff on their prompt handling of her request.
'Compliment' as a verb means express praise or admiration.
Online sales are expected to ____ during the holiday shopping season.
'Rise' is an intransitive verb meaning increase or move upward.
The manufacturer plans to ____ prices only if raw-material costs continue to increase.
'Raise' is a transitive verb meaning cause something to increase.
Of the two proposals, the ____ offers a shorter implementation schedule.
'Latter' refers to the second of two people or things just mentioned.
Customers should download the ____ version of the mobile application before contacting support.
____ lowering operating costs, the new system reduces the time needed to process orders.
'Besides' can mean in addition to and is followed here by a gerund phrase.
The document scanner is located ____ the reception desk on the first floor.
'Beside' means next to or at the side of something.
The revised program will benefit small retailers, ____ those with limited warehouse space.
'Especially' means particularly or above all, fitting the group singled out here.
The Tokyo and Osaka offices opened in 2018 and 2020, ____.
'Respectively' links items in two lists in the same order.
The monitoring system recorded temperature data ____ for 24 hours without interruption.
'Continuously' means without interruption, which is explicitly required by the context.
Once the safety inspection is complete, the installation team may ____ with the final testing stage.
'Proceed with' means continue with or begin the stated activity.
